summary: community.hashi_vault will drop several ansible-core and Python versions in v7.0.0, focusing on currently supported versions.
questions: Will community.hashi_vault 7.0.0 drop older ansible-core versions?

answer_card.title: community.hashi_vault v7 version support
answer_card.answer_md: In **v7.0.0**, community.hashi_vault will drop support for several ansible-core and Python versions, focusing on currently supported ansible-core releases and the Python versions they support on the controller, plus a subset of target versions.
